component.name: DKR-R
component.summary: Faithful and accurate cross-platform recompilation of Diddy Kong Racing

description.p: DKR Recompiled runs a legally obtained supported Diddy Kong Racing ROM through a native cross-platform recompilation runtime.
No ROM or extracted game assets are included in the application.

Improved online input recovery, lower-cost checkpoints, buffered spectators and live host settings. Added storage cleanup, a pinned Play button, native custom-character names, isolated file dialogs and better crash diagnostics.
Online responsiveness and sync presentation, a unified launcher and overlay, analogue driving, controller feedback, automatic seasons, languages, display options and opt-in crash reporting.
Analogue acceleration and braking, standalone online Look behind and full CRT controls in Graphics.
Online asset cache reuse, idle rendering fixes and fuller frame pacing diagnostics.
Responsive online input, proxy routes, lobby chat and live ping readings for every player.
Modded lobby joining, friends and profile pictures, remembered Linux sign-in and live field of view.
Memory and HUD safeguards, queued graphics ownership, water texture consistency and updated custom car support.
Modded lobby, race start and spectator fixes, offline mod copies and a tidier Open Lobbies screen.
Public online lobbies, spectators, vehicles, achievements and online reliability updates.
Mod Store, SDK 2.0, shared personal saves and presentation fixes.
